external_sources.title: Stacks Project, Lemma 30.8.1
external_sources.used: H^0(P^1_K,O(d))=0 for d<0 and H^1(P^1_K,O(d))=0 for d>=-1, over every field K. No vector-bundle splitting theorem is assumed.

attribution: Maintained paired-source convention and previous short-leg frontier retain their original credits. The Hankel interpolation and long-leg filtered-bundle argument are owner-directed OpenAI Codex continuation. No independent review or historical priority claim.

concurrent_work.credit: Concurrent interpolation bounds through p=a, an all-degree support floor and an exact a3 rank atlas are separate work. The common a2,p3 rank70 is reproduced as a control here. This bundle proof treats a longer interval and the full-row endpoint.
